error_handling.name: set_e_not_required
error_handling.sme_justification: Not present in EE2 standards or examples
error_handling.description:
Do **NOT** recommend adding these to operational scripts:

.. code-block:: bash

   set -e   # ❌ NOT required by EE2
   set -eu  # ❌ NOT required by EE2 (adds non-standard -u)
   set -euo pipefail  # ...
error_handling.suggested_fix: Remove set -e/set -eu/set -euo pipefail. Use err_chk after critical operations instead.

error_handling.name: forced_exit_prohibited

error_handling.suggested_fix: Remove explicit exit 0/exit 1 statements. Use 'export err=$?; err_chk' pattern after critical operations. Let the script flow terminate naturally.

error_handling.name: exit_status_pattern_prohibited

error_handling.suggested_fix: Replace 'if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi' with 'export err=$?; err_chk' after the operation.
